welle_e3.kreis.parteitag.ruhig: Ordinary party congress: you are confirmed unopposed
welle_e3.kreis.parteitag.ausserordentlic: Extraordinary party congress: the heir apparent does not run, you remain party leader
welle_e3.befund.titel: The service has found something on {name}
welle_e3.befund.text1: The review of {name} ({rolle}) is complete. Finding: {art}, severity {schwere} of 3.
welle_e3.befund.text2: So far only you and the service know. Loyalty today: {loy}.
welle_e3.befund.warum: You ordered the review in the inner circle.
welle_e3.befund.nutzen.label: Use it as leverage
welle_e3.befund.nutzen.beschr: {name} learns what you know. They will comply, but they will not forget.
welle_e3.befund.nutzen.zahlen: Loyalty {loy}, resentment {groll}, fear in the apparatus {angst}
welle_e3.befund.opfern.label: Demand resignation
welle_e3.befund.opfern.label_partei: Push out of the party leadership
welle_e3.befund.opfern.beschr: The case goes public and {name} leaves. The country sees resolve; the cabinet sees that nobody is safe.
welle_e3.befund.opfern.beschr_partei: The case goes public and {name} loses every party post for a year and a half.
welle_e3.befund.opfern.zahlen: Trust in government {vertrauen}, loyalty of every other minister {andere}
welle_e3.befund.opfern.sperre: An acting head or an office outside the government cannot be sacrificed this way.
welle_e3.befund.decken.label: Cover it up
welle_e3.befund.decken.beschr: The file stays in the drawer. {name} is grateful. The risk that the press finds it remains.
welle_e3.befund.decken.aus: The file on {name} disappears into the drawer.
welle_e3.befund.abwarten.label: Leave it
welle_e3.befund.abwarten.beschr: Nothing happens. {name} hears that the service was asking questions.
welle_e3.befund.abwarten.aus: The finding on {name} is shelved. They know about the review.
welle_e3.stufe.titel.3: {name} collects signatures for a party congress
welle_e3.stufe.text1.1: Succession pressure in the party has passed {schwelle} and stands at {druck}. {name} is inviting MPs and district chairs.
welle_e3.stufe.text1.2: Succession pressure stands at {druck}. In interviews, {name} says the party needs “a future after this term”.
welle_e3.stufe.text1.3: Succession pressure stands at {druck}. {name} is collecting delegates’ signatures. One fifth is enough to force an extraordinary congress.
welle_e3.stufe.termin.ordentlich: Next ordinary party congress: {datum, date}, in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
welle_e3.stufe.termin.ausserordentlich: Extraordinary party congress called: {datum, date}, in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
welle_e3.stufe.termin.drohend: Without a response the congress meets on {datum, date}, in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
welle_e3.stufe.warum: Succession pressure stands at {druck}. If it is {kampf} or higher at the next congress, the heir apparent runs against you.
welle_e3.stufe.abwarten.label: Wait
welle_e3.stufe.abwarten.beschr.2: {name} gets louder, and the party listens.
welle_e3.stufe.abwarten.beschr.3: {name} submits the signatures. The extraordinary congress will meet.
welle_e3.stufe.abwarten.aus3: {name} submits the signatures. The extraordinary congress meets in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
welle_e3.dienst.bericht.angeordnet: Ordered. Outcome in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}. Chance {p}%, risk of exposure {auf}%.
welle_e3.dienst.angeordnet: The service begins: {op}. Result in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
welle_e3.dienst.bindet: Ties up {kap} of the service’s capacity, outcome in {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
welle_e3.dienst.zugriff.erfolg: The wanted person is back in Türkiye. Capital +{kapital}, your own camp cheers.
welle_e3.dienst.zugriff.notiz: MİT brings wanted person back from {land}
welle_e3.dienst.zugriff.fehlschlag: The operation in {land} fails: the target had been warned.
welle_e3.dienst.zugriff.aufgeflogen: The press in {land} reports on the operation; human rights groups and the UNHCR protest.
welle_e3.dienst.kader.frieden: The peace process loses {punkte} points of progress.
welle_e3.dienst.kader.erfolg.pkk.schlag: The strike in {land} hits a senior PKK cadre. Its strength falls by {punkte} points.
welle_e3.dienst.kader.erfolg.pkk.festnah: A senior PKK cadre is captured in {land} and brought to Türkiye. Its strength falls by {punkte} points.
welle_e3.dienst.kader.erfolg.is.schlag: The strike in {land} hits an ISIS leader. Its strength falls by {punkte} points.
welle_e3.dienst.kader.erfolg.is.festnahm: An ISIS leader is cornered in {land}. Its strength falls by {punkte} points.
welle_e3.dienst.kader.fehlschlag: The strike in {land} misses its target.
welle_e3.dienst.kader.zwischenfall: Incident in {land}: bystanders are harmed and the government there protests.
welle_e3.dienst.kanal.erfolg: The exchange in Ankara succeeds. Washington and Moscow thank Türkiye.
welle_e3.dienst.kanal.fehlschlag: The exchange talks collapse over the last names on the list.
welle_e3.zugriff.titel: A wanted person has been spotted in {land}
welle_e3.zugriff.text1.guelen: The service reports: a man wanted on an arrest warrant, accused by Ankara of links to the Gülen movement, is living in {land}.
welle_e3.zugriff.text1.pkk: The service reports: a wanted PKK official is staying in {land}.
welle_e3.zugriff.text2: {name}: trust {vertrauen} of 100. Where the authorities cooperate, an operation succeeds more easily. Where the press is free, it becomes known.
welle_e3.zugriff.warum: Since 2016 MİT has brought back more than a hundred wanted people from abroad.
welle_e3.zugriff.opt.zugriff.label: Order the operation
welle_e3.zugriff.opt.zugriff.beschr: The service brings the person back, with the help of the local authorities if possible.
welle_e3.zugriff.opt.zugriff.auf: If exposed: {name}: trust {vertrauen}, standing {ansehen}, EU trust {eu}
welle_e3.zugriff.opt.auslieferung.label: Demand extradition
welle_e3.zugriff.opt.auslieferung.beschr: The official route via the courts and Interpol. It shows resolve but rarely brings the person back.
welle_e3.zugriff.opt.auslieferung.aus: Ankara demands extradition. {land|anfang} is reviewing the request.
welle_e3.zugriff.opt.abwarten.label: Let it go
welle_e3.zugriff.opt.abwarten.beschr: The service stays quiet and the target slips away.
welle_e3.zugriff.opt.abwarten.aus: The wanted person has moved on.
welle_e3.kader.text1.pkk: The service has tracked down a senior PKK cadre in {land}. PKK strength: {wert} of 100.
welle_e3.kader.text1.is: The service has tracked down an ISIS leader in {land}. ISIS strength: {wert} of 100.
welle_e3.kader.text2: The window is narrow: in two weeks he will have moved on.
welle_e3.kader.text2.frieden: The peace process stands at “{phase}”. A strike against the PKK sets it back.
welle_e3.kader.warum: MİT regularly hits cadres in Iraq and Syria; in 2023 it also killed the leader of ISIS.
welle_e3.kader.opt.schlag.label: Targeted strike
welle_e3.kader.opt.schlag.beschr.pkk: A service drone strikes in {land}. Fast, but the peace process suffers.
welle_e3.kader.opt.schlag.beschr.is: A service drone strikes in {land}. Fast and with little fuss.
welle_e3.kader.opt.festnahme.label: Capture on the ground
welle_e3.kader.opt.festnahme.beschr.pkk: A service team captures him in {land} with local partners. Harder, but he can be questioned.
welle_e3.kader.opt.festnahme.beschr.is: A service team corners him in {land}. Harder, but the world takes note.
welle_e3.kader.opt.erfolg.schlag: If it works: group strength {punkte}, terror threat {terror}, nationalists {nat}
welle_e3.kader.opt.erfolg.festnahme: If it works: group strength {punkte}, terror threat {terror}, nationalists {nat}, standing {ansehen}
welle_e3.kader.opt.auf: If there is an incident: {name}: trust {vertrauen}, tension {konflikt}
welle_e3.kader.opt.abwarten.label: Keep watching
welle_e3.kader.opt.abwarten.beschr: The service stays on him but does not act. The cadre keeps planning.
welle_e3.kader.opt.abwarten.aus.pkk: The PKK cadre has gone to ground.
welle_e3.kader.opt.abwarten.aus.is: The ISIS leader has gone to ground.
welle_e3.kanal.titel: Washington and Moscow are looking for a venue for an exchange
welle_e3.kanal.text1: Each side holds prisoners the other wants back. Through the service, they ask whether Ankara will host the exchange.
welle_e3.kanal.text2: Trust of the USA: {usa}, of Russia: {rus}. On 1 August 2024 seven states exchanged 26 prisoners in Ankara, handled by MİT.
welle_e3.kanal.warum: The service is one of the few channels both sides keep open.
welle_e3.kanal.opt.ausrichten.label: Host the exchange
welle_e3.kanal.opt.ausrichten.beschr: The service negotiates the lists and runs the handover in Ankara.
welle_e3.kanal.opt.ausrichten.erfolg: If it works: standing {ansehen}, trust of the USA and Russia {vertrauen} each
welle_e3.kanal.opt.ausrichten.fehlschlag: If it fails: trust of both {vertrauen} each
welle_e3.kanal.opt.abwarten.label: Leave it to others
welle_e3.kanal.opt.abwarten.beschr: Another mediator steps in, as the Emirates did for the Abu Dhabi exchange in 2022.
welle_e3.auf.text1: The “{op}” operation in {land} is public. {land|anfang} has summoned the ambassador and the press is asking questions.
welle_e3.auf.text2: How you respond now decides whether this lasts a day or a year.
welle_e3.auf.warum: An operation of the service has been discovered.
welle_e3.auf.dementieren.label: Deny it, state secret
welle_e3.auf.dementieren.beschr: The government denies everything and imposes a news blackout, as with the MİT trucks in 2014.
welle_e3.auf.dementieren.zahlen: Press freedom {presse}, trust in government {vertrauen}, {name}: trust {bez}
welle_e3.auf.dementieren.aus: Ankara denies it. Reporting on the operation in {land} is banned.
welle_e3.auf.opfern.label: Sacrifice those responsible
welle_e3.auf.opfern.beschr: The responsible unit is dissolved and its head goes. The service loses people; abroad, it reads as a signal.
welle_e3.auf.opfern.zahlen: Service capacity {kap}, {name}: trust {bez}, trust in government {vertrauen}
welle_e3.auf.opfern.aus: The unit is dissolved. {land|anfang} takes note of the gesture.
welle_e3.auf.bekennen.label: Own it
welle_e3.auf.bekennen.beschr: You face the cameras and defend the operation, as Erdoğan did in 2021 after the operation in Kyrgyzstan.
welle_e3.auf.bekennen.aus: You own the operation in {land}. Applause at home, outrage abroad.
welle_e3.auf.abwarten.label: Stay silent
welle_e3.auf.abwarten.beschr: The government says nothing. The press keeps digging.
welle_e3.auf.abwarten.aus: The government stays silent; the story stays in the papers.
welle_e3.fremd.text2: MİT has broken up networks like this for real: in January 2024 one run by Mossad, with 34 arrests.
welle_e3.fremd.warum: The service has uncovered the foreign operation.
welle_e3.fremd.abwarten.label: Wait
welle_e3.fremd.abwarten.beschr: The service only watches. The operation continues.
welle_e3.kz.parteitagWert: in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
